name: Cutting & Tailoring
summary: Your pattern is cut, assembled, and fitted on you in at least one in-progress session before finishing.
body: Once your pattern is drafted, fabric is cut by hand and basted together for a first fitting — this lets us adjust the garment on your actual body before final stitching, not after.
Structured pieces like jackets and gowns typically go through two fitting sessions; shirts, trousers and simpler pieces are usually finalised in one.
Every seam, buttonhole and hem is finished by our tailors on-site — nothing is outsourced mid-order.

seo.title: Cutting & Tailoring — Our Process
seo.description: Inside the cutting, basting and fitting stage of every garment made at Lipek Fashion.
